result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides, buffered by street trees and parallel parking. While the pedestrian environment is generally well-defined, the wide roadway and lack of visible crossings or traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: The absence of marked crossings or curb extensions means pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and parking without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained sidewalk in a commercial area with street trees and decorative lighting. On-street parallel parking provides a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic, though a lamp post is positioned in the middle of the walkway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A decorative lamp post is located in the center of the sidewalk, narrowing the clear walking path for those with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and the lamp post may obscure sightlines between drivers and pedestrians if mid-block crossing occurs.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the lamp post to the furniture zone closer to the curb to provide a continuous, unobstructed clear path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points or building entrances to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks with mature street trees providing a buffer from traffic. However, the roadway is a wide multi-lane arterial with a dedicated bus lane, which implies high vehicle volumes and long crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the multi-lane roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians crossing at the intersection ahead.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway extending to the horizon

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes without traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
